title: Doctors Say Pope Leo Recovering As Planned; Chest X-Ray Shows Good Lung Recovery
detail: On October 15 the Vatican said routine check-ups on Pope Leo yielded normal results and a chest X-ray showed good recovery of his lung. He carried out daily activities independently, did physiotherapy and resumed working from hospital. Tumour size and lymph-node involvement remain undisclosed; the pathology report, key to deciding further treatment, may take several days. Public engagements were cancelled through Oct 20.

media.caption: Pope Leo recovering as planned after cancer surgery
